source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The colored marker identifies the color used to mark every all-zero 2x2 square.
    marker = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 8)), 9)
    cells = set()
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == grid[r][c + 1] == grid[r + 1][c] == grid[r + 1][c + 1] == 0:
                cells.update(((r, c), (r, c + 1), (r + 1, c), (r + 1, c + 1)))
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = marker
    return out
'''
